using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Library;
using MediaBrowser.Model.Globalization;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.Tests
{
    public class BaseItemTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<BaseItem>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<ILocalizationManager> _localizationManagerMock;
        private readonly BaseItem _baseItem;

        public BaseItemTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<BaseItem>>();
            _localizationManagerMock = new Mock<ILocalizationManager>();

            // Create a concrete subclass to test protected method
            _baseItem = new TestBaseItem(_loggerMock.Object, _localizationManagerMock.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsParentalAllowed_UnrecognizedRating_LogsDebugMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var user = new UserDto
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                MaxParentalRatingScore = 5.0f,
                Policy = new UserPolicy
                {
                    BlockUnratedItems = new List<BlockUnratedType> { BlockUnratedType.Movie }
                }
            };

            _localizationManagerMock
                .Setup(x => x.GetRatingScore(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns((ParentalRatingScore?)null);

            // Act
            var result = _baseItem.IsParentalAllowed(user, false);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => t == "{0} has an unrecognized parental rating of {1}." && v.ToString().Contains("TestItem") && v.ToString().Contains("RATING")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.False(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IsParentalAllowed_ValidRatingScore_DoesNotLogDebug()
        {
            // Arrange
            var user = new UserDto { Id = Guid.NewGuid() };
            var ratingScore = new ParentalRatingScore { Score = 3.0f };

            _localizationManagerMock
                .Setup(x => x.GetRatingScore(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                .Returns(ratingScore);

            // Act
            var result = _baseItem.IsParentalAllowed(user, false);

            // Assert - No debug log should be called
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(LogLevel.Debug, It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(), It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Never);

            // Verify method logic works
            Assert.True(result);
        }

        private class TestBaseItem : BaseItem
        {
            private readonly ILogger<BaseItem> _logger;
            private readonly ILocalizationManager _localizationManager;

            public TestBaseItem(ILogger<BaseItem> logger, ILocalizationManager localizationManager)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                _localizationManager = localizationManager;
                Name = "TestItem";
                Logger = _logger;
            }

            public ILogger<BaseItem> Logger { get; }

            public override ILogger GetLogger() => Logger;

            // Expose protected method for testing
            public bool IsParentalAllowed(UserDto user, bool skipAllowedTagsCheck)
            {
                return base.IsParentalAllowed(user, skipAllowedTagsCheck);
            }

            // Mock protected methods
            protected override bool IsVisibleViaTags(UserDto user, bool skipAllowedTagsCheck) => true;
            protected override bool GetBlockUnratedValue(UserDto user) => true;
            public override string GetPreferredMetadataCountryCode() => "US";
        }
    }
}
